## Linear Algebra

Linear algebra studies [[vector-spaces|vector spaces]] and the linear maps between
them. The material is organised into the following notes.

1. [[vector-spaces]] - fields and vectors, linear combinations, span, independence,
   subspaces, basis and dimension.
2. [[linear-maps]] - linear maps, their matrices, change of basis, image, kernel and
   rank-nullity.
3. [[matrices]] - arithmetic, transpose, special matrices, row reduction,
   determinant, inverse, trace, rank and positive definiteness.
4. [[eigenvectors]] - eigenvalues, characteristic polynomial and diagonalisation.
5. [[inner-product-space]] - bilinear forms, inner products, Cauchy-Schwarz and the
   induced norm.
6. [[orthogonality-and-projections]] - orthogonality, Gram-Schmidt and projections.
7. [[matrix-decompositions]] - LU, QR, Cholesky, spectral decomposition and SVD.

Norms and metrics on vector spaces are covered in [[normed-space]] and
[[metric-spaces]]. Gradients, level sets and the Jacobian are covered in
[[vector-calculus]].
